To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

melt textured YBC0 with macroscopic grain alignment is a very promising material for electric power purposes, such as high-current leads and passive magnetic bearings, and that it can be manufactured in a way that is compatible with industrial production.

we have demonstrated the practical potential of bulk YBCO for electric power applications by constructing a high-current lead and a magnetic bearing with melt-textured material and by improving the performance of these devices to the point that they can be applied in the electric utility area.
melt textured YBC0 with macroscopic orientation is a promising material for electric power purposes.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a novel industrial like YBCO melt texture process for large area HTS devices, which are suitable for electric utility purposes.
the fabrication of HTS materials and devices with high current densities and high critical fields.
the development of high-temperature superconductors (HTS) for electric power purposes, in particular with the fabrication of melt-textured YBCO with a macroscopically aligned grain structure.

YBCO is a promising superconductor with high potential for electric power applications.

melt textured YBCOC is a very attractive material for high current applications, if the problems of grain boundary weakness and the anisotropy of the superconducting properties are solved.
